item.title: JDF makes $1.4 billion cocaine seizure offshore St Elizabeth - Jamaica Observer
item.description: KINGSTON, Jamaica — Over 2,500 kilograms of cocaine were seized offshore St Elizabeth over the weekend following the interception of a vessel travelling in Jamaican waters. The Maritime Air and Cyber Command of the Jamaica Defence Force seized the cocaine, which has an estimated street value of around $1.4 billion, from the vessel approximately 10 nautical miles (NM) southeast of Treasure Beach, St Elizabeth, on Saturday. item.title: St George’s appoints alumnus Andrew Price as technical director of football - Jamaica Observer
item.description: St George’s College (STGC) has appointed Andrew Price as technical director of its football programme, marking a significant &quot;homecoming&quot; for the veteran coach. Price, a distinguished alumnus and two-time &quot;Triple Champion&quot; for the &quot;Light Blues&quot;, will officially assume his role on April 1, 2026, following the conclusion of the current schoolboy football season, the school said in a press release. item.title: Partially buried body found in Greenwich Town - Jamaica Observer
item.description: KINGSTON, Jamaica — A body was found in a shallow grave in Greenwich Town, Kingston 13 on Monday. The body was reportedly discovered about 1:30 pm after a resident stumbled upon it in an area known as “Train Line” and alerted the police. Inclement weather prevented police from immediately processing the scene, but they are expected to do so on Tuesday.
